subtitle: Thola amagama afihliwe
short_description: Thola amagama amathathu afihliwe egridini ye-6×6 yezinhlamvu.
description:
Ipuzzle yamagama esiNgisi: thola amagama amathathu afihliwe egridini ye-6×6 yezinhlamvu. Igama ngalinye lihamba ngomugqa oqondile, ngokuqondile, ngokuthi phansi noma ngokuchezuka, futhi livela kanye kuphela.

Thepha inhlamvu yokuqala nowokugcina wegama, kuqondiswe noma yiluphi uhlangothi. Amagama atholakele ahlala egqanjiwe.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
